newsitem.title: USA: Auto sales in U.S. up 3.3 pct Feb 11-20 -- CNW.
newsitem.headline: Auto sales in U.S. up 3.3 pct Feb 11-20 -- CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States rose 3.3 percent in the 10 days of February 11-20 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos rose 3.7 percent, while U.S. sales of imports climbed 1.0 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales advanced 4.3 percent, to 208,073 from 199,530, CNW said. Domestic truck sales increased 2.8 percent, to 146,852 from 142,856, it said.
Import car sales rose 1.3 percent to 51,191, and import truck sales fell 0.4 percent to 10,772, the report said.
About 1.7 million vehicles had been sold in the United States so far in 1997, down 1.0 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
